corisk_vs_R05.HONEST_INTERPRETATION: Return-orthogonal IN THE MEAN (point cov -0.0044, ~81% bootstrap prob negative; full_cor -0.062). BUT: (1) cov_contribution 95% CI [-0.0149, +0.0056] STRADDLES ZERO -> diversification benefit is statistically UNCERTAIN, not confirmed. (2) cov flips POSITIVE (+0.0014) in R05-down months -> the (weak) benefit is concentrated in normal/up regimes; NOT a downside diversifier. (3) beta_down 95% CI [-0.53,+0.71] essentially unestimable -> NO hedge claim possible. (4) joint-left-tail TDC 0.13 [0.06,0.24] < 1 -> no evidence of crash clustering, but imprecise. NET: a weak return-orthogonal diversifier prior for the optimizer, NOT a hedge/defensive sleeve. Optimizer should treat the ΔIR benefit as a weak prior, not a fact.
